alt: Wide suburban road on North Parkway, Memphis, showing newly painted white lane markings with an orange traffic cone visible in the distance; TV chyron reads 'New Bike Lanes on Busy Street'
story: Memphis resurfaced North Parkway and installed new bike lanes on Nov 10, 2026, but the stripe design is immediately confusing — the two solid white lines marking parking spaces look like an extra-wide bike lane, signs are tiny, and cars were caught parked in the new bike lane within days.
why_funny: The entire point of a bike lane is to be unmistakably clear, and this one confused drivers and cyclists before the paint was dry.
